reviewNotice.title: Pending review by a CPA
reviewNotice.body: The Anejo N mapping is a descriptive guide: it groups your expenses by type, without confirmed line numbers. Ask your CPA to review it before you file.

index.title: Reports
index.description: Your numbers for the year, organized for Hacienda, the IRS and CRIM. Share them with your accountant.
index.annualBody: Rent collected, expenses by category, CRIM paid and depreciation per property. Export as PDF or CSV.
index.scheduleEBody: Summary by Schedule E line for owners who report to the IRS (non-residents of Puerto Rico).
index.crimBody: CRIM accounts, bills by fiscal year, payments and the estimated property tax for each property.

residency.title: Your tax residency
residency.description: Sets which report you see first. It is not a legal determination; confirm it with your CPA.
residency.label: Tax residency
residency.prHint: Bona fide Puerto Rico residents report rental income to Hacienda on the individual return (Anejo N). You'll see the annual package first.
residency.nonHint: If you are not a Puerto Rico resident, you usually report rental income to the IRS on Schedule E. You'll see Schedule E first.
residency.unsetHint: Pick an option to see the report that applies to you first. Until then you'll see the annual package.

annual.title: Annual package
annual.description: The year's income, expenses, CRIM and depreciation, ready for your accountant.
annual.scheduleENonResident: As a non-resident, also use the Schedule E summary and PDF for your federal return.
annual.scheduleEHint: This format groups by IRS Schedule E line. The official summary and its PDF are in the Schedule E section.

empty.title: You don't have any properties yet
empty.description: Add a property and record payments and expenses to build your annual package.

annual.estimatesHint: Items marked “Estimate” don't come from recorded payments. Review them with your accountant.

disclaimer.title: A summary, not a tax return
disclaimer.body: This package organizes the data you recorded in ContractOS. It is not tax advice and does not replace your Hacienda or IRS return. Your CPA decides how each item is reported.

source.ledger: Income: payments received in {year} from the rent ledger.
source.estimate: This property has no rent ledger: income is estimated from the signed lease's rent for the months of {year}.
source.mixed: Income: payments received in {year} and, for leases without a rent ledger, a monthly estimate.

table.noLines: No income or expenses recorded for this property in {year}.

annual.crimPaidNote: CRIM paid in {year}: {amount} (included in property tax).

depreciation.title: Depreciation inputs
depreciation.hint: Reference: 27.5-year straight line with the mid-month convention (IRS, residential property). In Puerto Rico your CPA decides the method and useful life. Estimate, non-binding.
depreciation.missing: Add the purchase price, the building share and the placed-in-service date to estimate depreciation.

scheduleE.12: Mortgage interest paid to banks, etc.

crim.sheetDescription: CRIM account, bills and data for your annual package.

estimate.title: Yearly property tax
estimate.missingRate: We couldn't find the rate for “{municipality}”. Check the municipality's spelling.
estimate.missingValue: Add the municipality and assessed value to see the estimate.
estimate.note: Estimated with the municipal real-property rate. The real amount is the one on your CRIM notice.

account.title: CRIM account
account.principalResidenceHint: Turn on if the property has the principal-residence exemption.
account.exonerationHint: The principal-residence exemption is usually up to $15,000 of assessed value. Use the figure on your CRIM notice.

depreciation.title: Depreciation inputs (optional)
depreciation.hint: Used only for the annual package estimate. Non-binding.

bills.title: CRIM bills
bills.empty: You haven't recorded CRIM bills for this property.
bills.label: Fiscal year {fy} · installment {n}
bills.voidAria: Void bill for fiscal year {fy}, installment {n}
bills.createExpenseHint: Creates a property expense so it counts in your reports.
bills.voidBody: The bill stays in the history as voided. Enter the reason.

crimPage.title: CRIM
crimPage.description: Property tax by property. Fiscal year {fy}.
crimPage.emptyTitle: You don't have any properties yet
crimPage.emptyBody: Add a property to track its CRIM account.
crimPage.note: Estimates use the fiscal year's municipal real-property rate. Tap a property to record its account, bills and payments.
